notes: Keyboard reset uses `setFocusable` guard before `blur()` to prevent WM stacking change: — when a focused window loses X11 focus (`blur()`), the WM typically raises the next focusable window, pushing ours behind it. Fix: call `setFocusable(false)` before `blur()`, setting `WM_HINTS.input=False`. When FocusOut fires, the WM sees the window is marked as not wanting input and (on this WM) does not raise another window. Then `setFocusable(true)` + `focus()` restores focus with a genuine FocusIn that re-registers GLib keyboard handlers — without any stacking change.
